```{r warning = FALSE}
library("pacman")
pacman::p_load(dada2, phyloseq, Biostrings, ggplot2, stringr, patchwork, RColorBrewer, fantaxtic, rmarkdown)
```

```{r}
#Read new phyloseq object (no need to rerun the previous code)
ps.anammox <- readRDS("ps.anammox1.all.rds")
ps.nitrificant_aoa <- readRDS("ps.nitrificant_aoa1.all.rds")
ps.nitrificant_aob <- readRDS("ps.nitrificant_aob1.all.rds")
ps.nitrificant <- readRDS("ps.nitrificant1.all.rds")
ps.nitrificant_nob <- readRDS("ps.nitrificant_nob1.all.rds")
ps.denitrificant <- readRDS("ps.denitrificant1.all.rds")
ps.planc <- readRDS("ps.planc1.all.rds")

#Read relative abundances phyloseq object
merged.ps <- readRDS("merged.ps.na.rds")
ps.rel <- transform_sample_counts(merged.ps, function(OTU) OTU/sum(OTU))

```

```{r}
#Plotting general top20 + anammox/nitrifiers subsets (REACTORS)
{
for(k in 1:2){    #Lanes
  assign(paste0("ps.l", k),
         subset_samples(merged.ps, Lane==paste0("L", k)))
  assign(paste0("plot.shannon.L", k), 
         plot_richness(get(paste0("ps.l", k)), x="Day",
                       measures="Shannon") +
           facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") +
           aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) + 
           labs(x = "Days", y = "Shannon Diversity Index") +
           ylim(3.5,6.5))
  
  ggsave(get(paste0("plot.shannon.L", k)), 
         file = paste0("plot.shannon.L", k, ".png"), 
         dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
  
  assign(paste0("plot.simpson.L", k), 
         plot_richness(get(paste0("ps.l", k)), x="Day",
                       measures="Simpson") +
           facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") +
           aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) +
           labs(x = "Days", y = "Simpson Diversity Index") +
           ylim(0.80,1.00))
  
  ggsave(get(paste0("plot.simpson.L", k)), 
         file = paste0("plot.simpson.L", k, ".png"), 
         dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
  
  assign(paste0("ps.planc.l", k),
         subset_samples(ps.planc, Lane==paste0("L", k)))
  assign(paste0("plot.planc.L", k),
         plot_bar(get(paste0("ps.planc.l", k)), x="Day", fill="Family") +
           theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
           facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") + 
           aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) + 
           labs(x = "Days", y = "Relative abundance")
           )
  
  ggsave(get(paste0("plot.planc.L", k)), 
         file = paste0("plot.planc.L", k, ".png"), 
         dpi = 350, width = 30, height = 30, units = "cm")
  
  
  for (j in 2:3){    #Reactors
    assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j),
           subset_samples(ps.rel, Lane==paste0("L", k) & Reactor==paste0("R", j)))
    assign(paste0("l", k, "_", j, ".top20"), 
           names(sort(taxa_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j))), decreasing=TRUE))[1:20])
    assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".top20"),
           prune_taxa(get(paste0("l", k, "_", j, ".top20")), get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j))))
    assign(paste0("plot.top20.L", k, "_", j),
           plot_bar(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".top20")), x="Day", fill="Genus") +
           facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") +
             aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) +
             ylim(0,0.6) + 
             scale_fill_manual(values = asvPalette_top20) +
             labs(x = "Days", y = "Relative abundance")
             )
    
    ggsave(get(paste0("plot.top20.L", k, "_", j)), 
           file = paste0("top20.L", k, "_", j, ".png"), 
           dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
    
    positions<-which(paste0("L", k) == sample_data(ps.anammox)$Lane)
    if (is.element(paste0("R", j),sample_data(ps.anammox)$Reactor[positions])==TRUE){
      if(k == 1){
        assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"),
             subset_samples(get(paste0("ps.anammox")), Lane==paste0("L", k) & Reactor==paste0("R", j)))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"),
             prune_samples(sample_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox")))>0, 
                           get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"))))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"),
             prune_taxa(taxa_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox")))>0, 
                        get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"))))
      assign(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".anammox"),
             plot_bar(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox")), x="Day", fill="Genus") + 
               facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") +
               aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) +
               ylim(0,0.06) + 
               scale_fill_manual(values = asvPalette_an) +
               labs(x = "Days", y = "Relative abundance")
               )
      
      ggsave(get(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".anammox")), 
             file = paste0("L", k, "_", j, ".anammox.png"), 
             dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
      }else{
        assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"),
             subset_samples(get(paste0("ps.anammox")), Lane==paste0("L", k) & Reactor==paste0("R", j)))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"),
             prune_samples(sample_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox")))>0, 
                           get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"))))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"),
             prune_taxa(taxa_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox")))>0, 
                        get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox"))))
      assign(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".anammox"),
             plot_bar(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".anammox")), x="Day", fill="Genus") + 
               facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") +
               aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) +
               ylim(0,0.003) + 
               scale_fill_manual(values = asvPalette_an) +
               labs(x = "Days", y = "Relative abundance")
               )
      
      ggsave(get(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".anammox")), 
             file = paste0("L", k, "_", j, ".anammox.png"), 
             dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
      }
    }  

    positions<-which(paste0("L", k) == sample_data(ps.nitrificant_aoa)$Lane)
    if (is.element(paste0("R", j),sample_data(ps.nitrificant_aoa)$Reactor[positions])==TRUE){    
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa"),
             subset_samples(get(paste0("ps.nitrificant_aoa")), Lane==paste0("L", k) & Reactor==paste0("R", j)))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa"),
             prune_samples(sample_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa")))>0, 
                           get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa"))))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa"),
             prune_taxa(taxa_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa")))>0, 
                        get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa"))))
      assign(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa"),
             plot_bar(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa")), x="Day", fill="Genus")+
               facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") +
               aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) + 
               ylim(0,0.2) + 
               scale_fill_manual(values = asvPalette_nit) +
               labs(x = "Days", y = "Relative abundance")
               )
      
      ggsave(get(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa")), 
             file = paste0("L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aoa.png"), 
             dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
    }
    
    positions<-which(paste0("L", k) == sample_data(ps.nitrificant_aob)$Lane)
    if (is.element(paste0("R", j),sample_data(ps.nitrificant_aob)$Reactor[positions])==TRUE){
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob"),
             subset_samples(get(paste0("ps.nitrificant_aob")), Lane==paste0("L", k) & Reactor==paste0("R", j)))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob"),
             prune_samples(sample_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob")))>0, 
                           get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob"))))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob"),
             prune_taxa(taxa_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob")))>0, 
                        get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob"))))
      assign(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob"),
             plot_bar(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob")), x="Day", fill="Genus")+
               facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") +
               aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) + 
               ylim(0,0.17) + 
               scale_fill_manual(values = asvPalette_nit) +
               labs(x = "Days", y = "Relative abundance")
               )
    
      ggsave(get(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob")), 
             file = paste0("L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_aob.png"), 
             dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
    }
    
    positions<-which(paste0("L", k) == sample_data(ps.nitrificant)$Lane)
    if (is.element(paste0("R", j),sample_data(ps.nitrificant)$Reactor[positions])==TRUE){
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant"),
             subset_samples(get(paste0("ps.nitrificant")), Lane==paste0("L", k) & Reactor==paste0("R", j)))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant"),
             prune_samples(sample_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant")))>0, 
                           get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant"))))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant"),
             prune_taxa(taxa_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant")))>0, 
                        get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant"))))
      assign(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant"),
             plot_bar(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant")), x="Day", fill="Genus") + 
               facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") +
               aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) + 
               ylim(0,0.2) + 
               scale_fill_manual(values = asvPalette_nit) +
               labs(x = "Days", y = "Relative abundance") 
               )
    
     ggsave(get(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant")), 
            file = paste0("L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant.png"), 
            dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
    }
    
    positions<-which(paste0("L", k) == sample_data(ps.nitrificant_nob)$Lane)
    if (is.element(paste0("R", j),sample_data(ps.nitrificant_nob)$Reactor[positions])==TRUE){
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob"),
             subset_samples(get(paste0("ps.nitrificant_nob")), Lane==paste0("L", k) & Reactor==paste0("R", j)))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob"),
             prune_samples(sample_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob")))>0, 
                           get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob"))))
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob"),
             prune_taxa(taxa_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob")))>0, 
                        get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob"))))
      assign(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob"),
             plot_bar(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob")), x="Day", fill="Genus")+
               facet_wrap(~Wrap, scales="free_x") +
               aes(x=reorder(Day,Date)) + 
               ylim(0,0.15) +
               scale_fill_manual(values = asvPalette_nob) +
               labs(x = "Days", y = "Relative abundance") 
               )
    
      ggsave(get(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob")), 
             file = paste0("L", k, "_", j, ".nitrificant_nob.png"), 
             dpi = 600, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
    }
    
    positions<-which(paste0("L", k) == sample_data(ps.denitrificant)$Lane)
    if (is.element(paste0("R", j),sample_data(ps.denitrificant)$Reactor[positions])==TRUE){
      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".denitrificant"),

      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".denitrificant"),

      assign(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".denitrificant"),
             prune_taxa(taxa_sums(get(paste0("ps.l", k, "_", j, ".denitrificant")))>0,

      assign(paste0("plot.L", k, "_", j, ".denitrificant"),
```
